name: Mirelurk Meat
blurb: The Mirelurk in Fallout 76 — drops Mirelurk Meat, Softshell Mirelurk Meat, 76 NPC variants, 234 known spawn points.

farming_tips.spawn_note: Mirelurk Meat comes from killing Mirelurks and looting the body.

ranks.desc: 40% chance to find extra meat from animal corpses.

consumption.note: Mirelurk Meat is a food consumable. It grants no timed stat buff on its own.
